settings.prior: retained v70 means, original training quantiles/copy/broad support; no public-input networks
settings.likelihood: variance-matched multivariate t5 with peer moments and shared-flight covariance
settings.measurement: retained taxi2 covariance plus retained departure t3 scale converted to variance
settings.calendars: own local takeoff runway cell; own once-estimated UTC off-block day
settings.comparison: joint posterior mean minus matched departure-only moment posterior mean
settings.transfer: one fixed half incremental correction through current v77 constraints
settings.common_error: ordinary mean perturbation includes probability flow across midnight
settings.scope: existing ambiguous Rome gap gate, original monthly quality gate, supported sources
settings.change: integrate each support state into its own UTC off-block day
settings.peers: all non-VFR flights in the held takeoff month contribute probability to interior UTC days
settings.moments: analytic normal interval moments; exact discrete long-flight calendar moments
settings.source_counts: expected membership count replaces hard day count in retained noise formula
settings.target_scope: old touched Rome rows only; every support day must be interior and source-supported
settings.fallback: original joint increment when any candidate day is unsupported
settings.calendar_noise: same retained per-day variance; no new fitted calibration

design.primary: replace fixed-day joint-minus-departure increment with uncertain-day increment, same half strength
design.scope: original touched Rome rows, all candidate days supported and interior; all other increments unchanged
design.prior: same serialized v70; same quantile/copy support; no public-input model enters prior
design.calibration: all original allowed-training parameters reused exactly
limitations: same day-specific calibration with expected counts
one-day edge exclusion may miss extreme multi-day peers
